title: Release center
subtitle: Installers · OTA updates · WPF POS · update policies

download.title: Install
download.iosEmptyBody: After registering and passing Apple verification, the install link and QR code appear here.
download.androidEmpty: No downloadable package in this environment
download.storeNote: The iOS link is the App Store product page and is not version specific; staff always get the version currently on the store.

qr.title: Scan to install
qr.iosHint: Scan with the camera to open the App Store and install or update.
qr.androidHint: Scan with an Android device to download. The link always points to the latest build; allow installing unknown apps the first time.
qr.buildHint: This link points to the package of this specific build.

policy.blocked: The bound release is no longer available

editor.enabledNativeHint: When off, clients stop receiving native update prompts
editor.enabledOtaHint: When off, clients stop receiving hot updates on this lane
editor.requiredHint: When on, clients must install this update before continuing
editor.minimumHint: Leave empty for optional updates only; when set, clients below this version must update.
editor.messagePlaceholder: Shown in the in-app update prompt

releases.title: App Store releases
releases.note: Registering only records a release and never changes the policy.

register.title: Register App Store release
register.subtitle: Verifies the listing with Apple and records the release without changing the policy.

registered: Registered; policy state was not changed
conflict: Policy version conflict. Latest state was reloaded; review it before saving again
readbackFailed: Write completed, but authoritative readback failed. Refresh to verify

validation.releaseRequired: Select a release before enabling the policy
validation.minimumVersionRequired: Enter a minimum version before setting a minimum Build
validation.minimumBuildInvalid: Minimum Build must be an integer from 0 to 2147483647
validation.storesRequired: Select at least one store for a store scoped policy
validation.candidateBlocked: The selected candidate is not activatable; choose an activatable candidate
validation.appStoreIdInvalid: App Store ID must contain 6 to 20 digits
validation.buildNumberInvalid: Build does not match the format required by this app
